description: Call this when someone asks about unemployment benefits after a layoff or job loss, for example "can I get unemployment in Texas" or "does severance affect my unemployment". Unemployment insurance basics for one U.S. state: the state agency and where to file, maximum and minimum weekly benefit, maximum weeks, whether there is a waiting week, how severance and pay in lieu of notice are treated, and the work-search rule. Each fact carries its official source and the date it was checked.
name: unemployment_benefits_by_state
title: Unemployment benefits by state
